name: Paper Plane Send
description: A send button whose glyph folds into a paper plane and flies off on a dashed trail, circling while a promise is pending.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called on press by mouse, touch or keyboard. Return a promise and the plane circles until it settles: it flies off when the promise resolves and glides home when it rejects.

props.name: labels
props.type: { idle?: ReactNode; sending?: string; sent?: string; failed?: string }
props.description: idle replaces children. The others show in turn and are announced to screen readers. The width is kept from the widest, so it never jumps.

props.name: variant
props.description: Ink, water or card, as Button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button. The button sets aria-busy while it sends.
